description: Aggregate per-provider cost + latency + quality (from `InferenceProviderABTestComponent` outputs + optional `ProviderABEvaluatorComponent`) into ONE 'should we go local' report asset. Materialize on a daily schedule and the report becomes a time-series in Dagster+ Insights.

outputs.description: One asset with per-provider metrics + winner-by-cost + winner-by-quality + winner-by-value + projected daily savings + recommendation string.

candidates.label: Candidates
candidates.description: Upstream A/B candidate asset keys. Each provides cost_usd + latency_ms + tokens_* in its payload.

evaluator.label: Evaluator Asset
evaluator.description: Optional upstream evaluator asset key. Provides quality scores per provider.

baseline_alias.label: Baseline Alias
baseline_alias.description: Reference provider alias. Deltas (cost, quality) are computed relative to this.

projected_daily_volume.label: Projected Daily Volume
projected_daily_volume.description: Optional projected daily call volume. Enables `projected_daily_savings_usd` per alternative.

quality_weight.label: Quality Weight
quality_weight.description: 0-1. Weight applied to quality in the value_score composite (cost gets 1 - weight). Higher = quality matters more.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Must match upstream candidate + evaluator partitions_def.

name: Inference Cost Report
